verdict.rationale: Founders Workbench is a set of free web tools (Document Driver, Capital and Liquidation Calculators), so opting out of usage tracking is a fair privacy question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence describes telemetry, analytics, cookie or tracking controls, or any opt-out mechanism. The Data, Privacy & Cybersecurity page describes a legal practice, not the product's own tracking, so it does not bear on this story.
